limitations: AI review, no external legal expert supervision or human candidate difficulty calibration.
Regional ordinances and actual plot-specific administrative judgments need the competent authority.

All 34条 location categories, every zoning-use combination, all forest/park exceptions, every special height-relaxation technique, and every other individual land statute are not independently assessed by this release. Existing numbered official-domain mapping must not be presented as proof of exhaustive statutory coverage.

Public legal XML APIs were used to read definitions and procedures; the legal-reference date is separated from later MLIT notices. Cultural law API retrieval failed; Culture Agency current guidance and the publicly supplied related-article PDF supplied the stated93条 rule.

languageReview.method: Separate sentence-continuity and proofreading pass using japanese-textbook-editing, natural-japanese, humanizer, proofread-ja. Facts and numerical conditions rechecked after edits.
languageReview.automatedLint: Attempted natural-japanese lint on tk-height-control. Unavailable because SudachiPy is absent. Manual context review completed; no grammar score is claimed.

benchmark.observed: Defines the subject, explains its purpose, then connects the same idea to a visible representation. Original prose uses first-use definitions before rule application.
Makes a distinction explicit before checking consequences in contrasted cases. Original legal examples change one consequential fact at a time.

Read freely downloadable2026法令制限図表集. Organizes system, rule/exception and paired comparisons. Used only as pedagogy/structure benchmark; all prose, data, diagrams and exercises here are original, and legal facts independently checked against government sources.
Freely readable development-permission question demonstrates switching decisions using area/purpose/location conditions. No question or answer is reproduced.

newChapterDecision.reason: Plan stage, project stage and district notification require independent decisions and exceptions before development/building.
Use legality and fire boundary rules use different objects from area calculations; they need their own worked practice.
Fill rules have distinct regional thresholds, exclusions, timelines and legal roles; original combined chapter introduced only the system.
Forest designation, felling/development/acquisition and natural-park overlap add independent permission/notification decisions.
Landscape, buried-cultural-property and public preemption require distinct legal actors and notification time origins.
An independent cumulative dossier is needed before an unfamiliar multi-law exam task.
Height, setbacks, slope and shadow are methods distinct from area ratios; the former chapter only named them.
Floor-area exclusions require classifying actual parts, selecting denominators and caps, and avoiding double deductions.

sourceAccessNotes: e-Gov law pages have no readable lines in web rendering. The official /api/1/lawdata XML was retrieved for urban planning, building, agriculture, national land, readjustment, fill, building order, fill order/rule, forest, natural park, landscape and public-land laws. April1 references and primary explanatory notices were kept separate from later updates. No source-protected diagrams or examination questions were copied.
